ModMetaData.name: Society: Estates
ModMetaData.author: Cashew
ModMetaData.description:
Part of the Society suite. Your royals run the colony's estates and act on its behalf.
Colony management: a new button on the Castes tab opens the Colony management window. On its Colony needs tab, search for items and say how many the colony should keep on hand ("Medicine: 30"), with an optional price cap per item and a silver reserve that's never spent.
Royal purchases: when a trade caravan visits (RimMarket stall merchants too) and carries something the colony is short of, the free royal with the best trade prices walks over, talks with the merchant and buys what's needed with the colony's silver, top of the list first. A letter lists what they bought.
Royals are Society: Castes nobles and anyone with an Empire title.
